name: Nomusa Nkosi
bio:
Nomusa's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the University of Cape Town, she volunteered at a local racing team to gain practical experience. Her sharp analytical skills and innate ability to streamline processes quickly caught the attention of the team principal. She transitioned from volunteer to a junior engineer within a year, proving her worth through meticulous attention to detail and a relentless pursuit of efficiency. 

Joining Prema Racing five years ago, Nomusa has steadily risen through the ranks. As Head of Operations, she oversees all logistical and strategic planning for the team, ensuring smooth execution on and off the track. Nomusa is known for her pragmatic approach and data-driven decision-making, always striving to optimize performance while maintaining a calm and composed demeanor even under immense pressure. Her unique ability to see both the minute details and the grand scheme of things makes her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled natural hair with subtle highlights
physical.description: Nomusa is a slender woman with a focused gaze and an air of quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously organized lists.
Has a specific playlist of calming music she listens to before every race.
Insists on double-checking all critical calculations, even when others have already confirmed them.
